name: Global Village
excerpt: The Global Village describes the shrinking of time and space due to technological advancements.
notes: The Global Village refers to the shrinking of time and space as air travel and electronic media make it easier to communicate around the globe, effectively making the world smaller.
context_summary:
- The Global Village describes the shrinking of time and space.
- Technological advancements facilitate global communication.
- Air travel and electronic media contribute to making the world smaller.
